recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is. Do not revert the later markdown, repeatable rater, THO terminology, or example-binding changes under FHIR-28920; any future tightening of Evidence certainty terminology should follow the EBMonFHIR/terminology path referenced by FHIR-53156.
issue_request: FHIR-28920 was Published/Persuasive for R5 from the CDS work group. It requested streamlining Evidence.certainty by using a repeating BackboneElement with description, note, type, rating, rater, and recursive subcomponent, along with unified EvidenceCertaintyType and EvidenceCertaintyRating bindings and updated descriptors.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied in source history: f7c29e888c changed the ASTRAL Evidence example from old certaintySubcomponent and split code systems to unified certainty-type/certainty-rating codes and subcomponent, while the R5 source rework in 33b409a4b6 and bcd36a75b4 carried the recursive Evidence.certainty shape into source/evidence/structuredefinition-Evidence.xml.
additional_context: Later final decisions explain current differences from the 2020 request: FHIR-39572 changed Evidence.certainty.description to markdown, FHIR-48987 changed Evidence.certainty.rater to 0..* and corrected a temporary rating/rater cardinality mix-up, FHIR-39632 moved duplicate terminology definitions out of core to THO, and FHIR-53156 changed Evidence certainty bindings to example strength with EBMonFHIR IG comments. FHIR-28921 is tightly related but already has a separate external-repo audit commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Evidence is active in source/fhir.ini, current Evidence.certainty has the recursive subcomponent contentReference and expected child elements, examples use the streamlined representation, and searches found no stale certaintySubcomponent source needing repair.
